In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-3-7 hexagonal honeycomb''' or ('''6,3,7 honeycomb''') a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) with [[Schläfli symbol]] {6,3,7}.

== Geometry==
All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with seven hexagonal tilings existing around each edge and with an [[order-7 triangular tiling]] [[vertex figure]].

{| class=wikitable width=480
|+ Ideal surface
|- valign=top
|[[File:H3 637 UHS plane at infinity view 1.png|240px]]<BR>Rendered intersection of honeycomb with the ideal plane in [[Poincaré half-space model]]
|[[File:H3 637 UHS plane at infinity view 2.png|240px]]<BR>Closeup
|}

== Related polytopes and honeycombs ==
It a part of a sequence of [[regular polychora]] and honeycombs with [[hexagonal tiling]] [[cell (geometry)|cells]].
{{hexagonal tiling cell tessellations}}

In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-3-8 hexagonal honeycomb''' or ('''6,3,8 honeycomb''') is a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) with [[Schläfli symbol]] {6,3,8}. It has eight [[hexagonal tiling]]s, {6,3}, around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many hexagonal tilings existing around each vertex in an [[order-8 triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

{| class=wikitable
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 6-3-8 poincare.png|240px]]<BR>[[Poincaré disk model]]
<!--|[[File:H3_638_UHS_plane_at_infinity.png|240px]]<BR>Ideal surface-->
|}

It has a second construction as a uniform honeycomb, [[Schläfli symbol]] {6,(3,4,3)}, Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|6|node|split1|branch|label4}}, with alternating types or colors of tetrahedral cells. In Coxeter notation the half symmetry is [6,3,8,1<sup>+</sup>] = [6,((3,4,3))].

{{Clear}}

In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-3-infinite hexagonal honeycomb''' or ('''6,3,∞ honeycomb''') is a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) with [[Schläfli symbol]] {6,3,∞}. It has infinitely many [[hexagonal tiling]] {6,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many hexagonal tilings existing around each vertex in an [[infinite-order triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

{| class=wikitable
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 6-3-i poincare.png|240px]]<BR>[[Poincaré disk model]]
|[[File:H3_63i_UHS_plane_at_infinity.png|240px]]<BR>Ideal surface
|}

It has a second construction as a uniform honeycomb, [[Schläfli symbol]] {6,(3,∞,3)}, Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|6|node|split1|branch|labelinfin}}, with alternating types or colors of hexagonal tiling cells.
